title.zh: 香港将于10月13日上市第二只现货Solana ETF（Pando Solana ETF）
title.en: Hong Kong to list second spot Solana ETF (Pando Solana ETF) on Oct. 13

current_state.zh: Pando 将其现货 Solana ETF 的香港上市日期定在 10 月 13 日，收取 0.60% 的年度管理费，与华夏基金现有的 Solana ETF 展开竞争，后者截至 8 月底持有 858 万美元。
current_state.en: Pando set an Oct. 13 Hong Kong listing date for its spot Solana ETF, charging a 0.60% annual management fee and competing with ChinaAMC's existing Solana ETF, which held $8.58 million at the end of August.

updates.title_zh: 中国香港将于10月13日上市第二只现货Solana ETF
updates.title_en: 中国香港将于10月13日上市第二只现货Solana ETF
updates.what_changed_zh: 香港将于 10 月 13 日在香港交易所上市其第二只现货 Solana ETF——Pando Solana ETF（2831.HK），全球现货 SOL ETF 净资产为 19 亿美元，累计净流入为 16.1 亿美元。
updates.what_changed_en: Hong Kong is set to list its second spot Solana ETF, Pando Solana ETF (2831.HK), on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange on October 13, with global spot SOL ETF net assets at $1.9 billion and cumulative net inflows of $1.61 billion.
updates.current_state_zh: 香港将于 10 月 13 日在香港交易所上市其第二只现货 Solana ETF——Pando Solana ETF（2831.HK），全球现货 SOL ETF 净资产为 19 亿美元，累计净流入为 16.1 亿美元。
updates.current_state_en: Hong Kong is set to list its second spot Solana ETF, Pando Solana ETF (2831.HK), on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange on October 13, with global spot SOL ETF net assets at $1.9 billion and cumulative net inflows of $1.61 billion.

updates.detailed_summary_en: Hong Kong is set to list its second spot Solana ETF, Pando Solana ETF (2831.HK), on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange on October 13, with global spot SOL ETF net assets at $1.9 billion and cumulative net inflows of $1.61 billion.

updates.title_zh: 【Pando Solana ETF 将于 10 月 13 日在港交所上市】
updates.title_en: 【Pando Solana ETF 将于 10 月 13 日在港交所上市】
updates.what_changed_zh: 新增细节：Pando Solana ETF 预计年费率为1.6%，将通过HashKey持有SOL，且不进行质押、不使用杠杆、不派发股息。
updates.what_changed_en: Added details: the Pando Solana ETF is expected to have a 1.6% annual fee, hold SOL through HashKey, and not engage in staking, use leverage, or pay dividends.
updates.current_state_zh: 中国香港计划于10月13日在港交所上市第二只现货Solana ETF，即Pando Solana ETF（2831.HK）；该ETF预计年费率为1.6%，将通过HashKey持有SOL，且不进行质押、不使用杠杆、不派发股息。
updates.current_state_en: Hong Kong is set to list its second spot Solana ETF, Pando Solana ETF (2831.HK), on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange on October 13; the ETF is expected to have a 1.6% annual fee, hold SOL through HashKey, and not engage in staking, use leverage, or pay dividends.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Pando's Solana ETF is set to list on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange on October 13 with an estimated 1.6% annual fee, holding SOL through HashKey without staking, leverage, or dividend payouts.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Pando's Solana ETF is set to list on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange on October 13 with an estimated 1.6% annual fee, holding SOL through HashKey without staking, leverage, or dividend payouts.
